patch.value: PR187 toolchain bump still fails the two missing-configuration read fixtures

Tracks gh:unbraind/pm-linear#188 (filed 2026-10-28, missed by the blind issue watch). The open toolchain PR #187 (2026.10.24 to .25) still fails test(22)/test(26)/release-gates (latest run 41327000072, 2026-11-01): dependency-closure.test.ts and ownership.test.ts expect readClosureItems/read-only previews to backfill missing schema/settings/history through SDK reads, but both now throw LinearClosureRefusal/LinearOwnershipRefusal (local_read_failed) because the reader repairs only settings in its disposable bootstrap and then unconditionally copies bootstrap/schema into the final reader. Update the fixtures or the reader contract for the .25 SDK so missing-configuration reads complete locally before any SDK backfill, then land the bump.
